spans.s: मोक्तुकाम, i. e. मोक्तुम्-काम (infin. of मुच्), adj. Desiring to cast,
मोक्ष्, i. 10 (properly a denomin. derived from मोक्स्ह), and † i. 1, Par. (in epic poetry also Ātm.,

. † To cast.
 --Comp. ptcple. of the pres. अ-मोक्षयन्त्, adj. Neglecting to liberate, Yājñ. 2, 300.
 --With the prep. परि परि, To release, to liberate, Weber, Ind. St. iii. 371, 4, below.
 --With वि वि, To release, to protect,

मोक्स्ह् + अ (मोक्स्ह् is an anomal. desider. of मुच्), m.
 1. Untying, Pañc. 109, 9;
. Liberation of the soul from the body and from further transmigration, final beatitude,

मोक्स्ह् + अक, adj. and sbst., m.
 1. One who sets at liberty,

मोक्षण, i. e. मोक्स्ह् + अन, n.
 1. Letting go (shedding of blood), Mālav. d. 62.
 2. Liberation, Pañc. 143, 6.
 3. Squandering.
 --Comp.
+ समाचार मोक्ष-क्रिया- + समाचार, adj. affording a way for liberating, Pañc. 109, 11.
